name: Roy Henrik
source:
The Blue Princess' (Tereza) older brother.

He tries to bring about the Blue Age.

He is an idealist and has a good look, very similar to Tereza.

He is friendly and charming.

Tereza has a huge brother complex for him.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040202001505/http://www.cherrysoft.co.jp/cherrysoft/kyrie.htm]the official site[/url]]
